Container.Name: SCUM Dedicated Server
Container.Overview: Community-maintained SCUM dedicated server on Wine with SteamCMD updates, a web dashboard, and unified web/SFTP user management. SCUM game files download on first launch and are not included in the image.
Container.Description: Windows SCUM dedicated server hosted under Wine. Includes dashboard controls, uptime, logs and SFTP accounts using the same credentials as panel users. The master administrator token and initial legacy SFTP password are configured through environment variables. Data is stored under /data. Forward game ports only; put the HTTP dashboard behind your own HTTPS reverse proxy or VPN.
Container.Requires: Unraid 7 on x86-64, 16 GB or more available RAM, enough disk space for SCUM/SteamCMD and persistent saves. Linux host vm.max_map_count of at least 1048576 recommended. Verify graceful Docker stop timeout for SCUM.

Config.Name: Game Data
Config.Description: Persistent installation, world saves, auth, and logs

Config.Name: SFTP_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required legacy scum SFTP account password

Config.Name: MANAGER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Required master admin token; use a long random value

Config.Name: UPDATE_ON_START
Config.Description: Check for SteamCMD updates at startup

Config.Name: WEB_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set true when dashboard is accessed exclusively over HTTPS behind a reverse proxy; false for initial LAN HTTP testing
